questions.answer: Very

questions.question: Additional comments
How well did the academic level at UCPH coincide with the tasks completed during your traineeship? *
questions.answer: I would say very

questions.question: Please elaborate *
questions.answer: My traineeship involved scRNA-seq and flow cytometry data analysis, both of which were practiced and talked about in my lectures, and the traineeship required threorical knowledge in immunology and biomedical sciences which my courses had provided beforehand. Overall I think the traineeship was very appropriate for a MSc thesis

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Regarding the costs I was covered by the receiving institute (therefore the 0 value), my housing was student housing, and my transportation was cycling and public transports during the snowy months (therefore the value was the total spend divided by the 9 months i was abroad), I had internet at my place, and kept using my Portuguese phone number

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available at your traineeship destination (organization/city/region)? *
questions.answer:
Karolinska has a free gym and plentiful of social activities through I did not participate that much
Stockholm is a huge city with plenty of cultural, athletic and social activities though I did not go out that much besides the gym

questions.question: Which non-academic activities would you recommend to future trainees visiting the same destination (organization/city/region)? Why? *
questions.answer: Cultural activities such as visiting the city and the lakes, St Lucia Carols, Walpurgis Night

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting trainees see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: The Cultural activities I mentioned before, and even though I didnt I would reccomend visiting the places around Stockholm like Upssala

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your trainee host? *
questions.answer: Very, Karolinska tends to be a very open, tolerant, international, and passionate environment

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of the destination (city/country)? *
questions.answer: Very, it is very similar to the Danish culture

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with locals? *
questions.answer: Go to Fika, happy hour events, and seminars

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Swedes can be very non-confrontational, which is good, but sometimes it might be hard to understand if something is wrong if someone such as myself comes from a more confrontational culture (Portuguese)

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Fika, the respect for life-work balance, non-confrontational nature, love of nature seen in their urbanism (always close to a forest)

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going on a traineeship to the same city/region? *
questions.answer:
-There is no bad weather, only bad clothes (bring warm clothes, do not bike when there is snow or buy accessories for the bike tires)
-Do enjoy the cultural events of the city as much as possible
-Try to do a lot of networking

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future traineeship students? *
questions.answer: Even if Arlanda Express is more expensive it is still the best way to get from the airport to the city and it is worth it

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your traineeship experience? *
questions.answer: Experiencing the amazing research environment of KI (e.g. lectures by the people who had won the Nobel in medicine or physiology in 2025)

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the traineeship? *
questions.answer: Dealing with changes in the original plans regarding technical design and experimental goals

questions.question: Is there anything UCPH could have done different (before/during/after) in regard to the traineeship experience? *
questions.answer: I do not thing so

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
